plugins/hygeabe/plugin_info/configuratio.Secondes avant d'abandonner un appel à l: Seconds before giving up on an API call. 10 is right in almost every case.
plugins/hygeabe/plugin_info/configuratio.Nombre de jours de collectes demandés à: Number of days of collections requested on each refresh. Beyond 60 days the calendar is usually not published yet.
plugins/hygeabe/plugin_info/configuratio.Langue dans laquelle le service renvoie: Language in which the service returns waste type names ("Organic waste", "PMD"...). Commands already created keep their name, only the value changes.

plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Aucune adresse pour le moment. Pour déma: No address yet. To get started:
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Cliquez sur « Ajouter une adresse » et d: Click "Add an address" and give it a name, for example "Collections".
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Saisissez le code postal, puis choisisse: Enter the postal code, then choose the locality offered.
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Saisissez les premières lettres de la ru: Enter the first letters of the street, then pick it from the list.
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Indiquez le numéro de maison et enregist: Enter the house number and save: the commands are created and the calendar is fetched.
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Chercher les localités de ce code postal: Search the localities of this postal code
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Tapez le code postal puis cliquez sur la: Type the postal code then click the magnifier: one postal code may cover several localities.
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Le numéro de maison sert à départager le: The house number tells apart streets collected in two rounds. Without it, the calendar may be the one of the neighbour across the road. The service only accepts an integer: suffixes and letters are not passed on to it.
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Relit le calendrier de l'adresse enregis: Reads the calendar of the saved address again. Pointless right after a save, which already does it.
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Crée, pour chaque type de déchet rencont: Creates, for each waste type found in the calendar, its next collection date and the number of days left. Handy for a scenario watching a single bin.
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Heure à partir de laquelle la collecte d: Hour from which today's collection is considered done and "Next collection" jumps to the following one. 0 keeps it displayed all day, 9 switches it after the truck has passed.
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Les collectes connues pour cette adresse: The collections known for this address, as the service publishes them. This calendar is read again on every refresh.
Be reminded without writing a scenario.
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Un rappel choisit le moment, les déchets: A reminder picks the moment, the waste it watches, and what it triggers: a notification, an SMS, a spoken message, a lamp — any action command of your Jeedom. A reminder that matches no waste of the collection stays silent.
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Jetons utilisables dans le titre et le m: Tokens usable in the title and the message
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Les déchets concernés, séparés par des v: The waste concerned, comma separated: "PMD, Paper and cardboard". A filtered reminder only names the waste it watches.
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Le jour de la collecte, toujours en tout: The day of the collection, always spelled out: "Thursday 17/09".
The number of days before the collection.
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Les jetons de Jeedom restent utilisables: Jeedom's own tokens still work on top: #[Object][Device][Command]#, variable(), and so on.
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Faire taire les rappels une fois les pou: Silence the reminders once the bins are out.
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.La commande « C’est fait » de cet équipe: This device's "Done" command declares the bins of the next collection out; "Not out yet" cancels. Reminders with "Do not send if already done" ticked then stay silent until the collection, after which everything starts afresh. Call "Done" from the tile, a scenario, or the button of a JeedomConnect notification.
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Jouée à chaque confirmation « C’est fait: Played on each "Done" confirmation, for instance a "Thanks, reminders off" notification. The reminder tokens work here.
plugins/hygeabe/desktop/php/hygeabe.php.Ces actions sont jouées une fois par col: These actions are played once per collection, when "Done" is pressed. Pressing it again does not replay them.
